versions.changelog:
Initial release of Cell Schema Generator skill.

- Generates CellOS-compatible YAML schemas from free-text organizational descriptions
- Ensures all five steward roles are assigned (or marked TBD if unassigned)
- Produces explicit in-scope and out-of-scope boundaries
- Specifies escalation rules with clear triggers, targets, methods, and timeouts
- Outlines coordination protocols with direction, cadence, and format
- Includes a "Design Notes" commentary section to explain decisions and highlight gaps or risks
